fullContentHtml:
IRCTC Recruitment 2026 Notification Out – Walk in for 28 Hospitality Monitors and Tourism Monitors Posts - Complete Details

Indian Railway Catering & Tourism Corporation Ltd (IRCTC) has announced the Recruitment 2026 notification for 28 vacancies, including Hospitality Monitors and Tourism Monitors posts. Eligible candidates can attend the walk-in interview from 05 October 2026 to 09 October 2026 at the designated venue. The detailed notification is available on the official website, irctc.com.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 16.09.2026
  • Walk-in interview dates : Hospitality Monitors - 05.10.2026 (Bhubaneswar) and 08.10.2026 (Hyderabad); Tourism Monitors - 06.10.2026 (Bhubaneswar) and 09.10.2026 (Hyderabad)

Application Fee

  • Total Posts : 22 (includes 4 OBC backlog vacancies)
  • Place of posting : Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Maharashtra, Odisha, and Chhattisgarh (candidates may be posted anywhere in India at IRCTC's discretion)
  • Post : Address
  • Institute of Hotel Management (IHM), F-Row, Vidya Nagar, DD Colony, Hyderabad, Telangana 500007 : 08.10.2026
  • IRCTC Ltd, 1st Floor, Oxford Plaza, Sarojini Devi Road, Secunderabad-500003 : 09.10.2026
  • Post : Number of Posts
  • (1) Full time B.Sc. in Hospitality and Hotel Administration from a Central or State institute of Hotel Management (CIHM/SIHM/PIHM) affiliated to NCHM&CT/UGC/AICTE/Government of India (2) BBA/MBA (Culinary Arts) from Indian Culinary Institutes under Ministry of Tourism (3) B.Sc. Hotel Management and Catering Science from Government-recognized Universities affiliated to UGC/AICTE/Government of India/State Government (4) M.B.A (Tourism and Hotel Management) from Government-recognized Universities affiliated to UGC/AICTE/Government of India/State Government : Upto 28 years*
  • 3-Years Bachelor degree in Tourism; OR 3-Years bachelor degree in any stream + 1-year diploma in Travel & Tourism : Minimum 1 year working experience in Tour Operation/Travel Agency Firms
  • 3-years Bachelor Degree in any stream + 2-years Post Graduation Degree/Diploma in Travel & Tourism : Minimum 2 years working experience in Tour Operation/Travel Agency Firms

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
